subject: Concluding MAP & eval gate — paperstack timing for launch window
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Leslie Hahn <leslie@nimbushealth.com>, Jordan Pierce <jordan.pierce@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Concluding MAP & eval gate — paperstack timing for launch window

Team / Nimbus —

We’re at the tail end of the mutual action plan and the evaluation window. Quick recap and asks so we can finalize the paperflow and lock the start date: 

- MAP items: legal redlines cleared (see attached MAP_Nimbus_v3.pdf). Legal asked for one small addition aligning data retention with Nimbus’ retention policy.
- Eval: perf summary attached (nimbus-eval-summary.xlsx) — latency/quality look good for the canary profile; sample prompts passed the regression gate.
- Signatures: Nimbus confirmed two signers (Leslie + Jordan). We need to agree on an Esign timeline so procurement can route documents next week.
- Start date: Nimbus indicated preferred start 2026-12-06; we should confirm internal readiness windows and the dedicated capacity ramp.

Can Kimberly confirm if we can accept the suggested data retention clause as-is or whether Legal needs a short alternate text? Marissa — can you confirm ops runbook/CS onboarding readiness for a 2026-12-06 start if docs are fully executed by 11/18?

If everyone is aligned we’ll send the DocuSign packet Monday and ask Nimbus to sign within 48 hours so we can hit the target.

Thanks —
Rishi
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_Nimbus_v3.pdf (MAP v3, redlines included), nimbus-eval-summary.xlsx (eval highlights)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Concluding MAP & eval gate — paperstack timing for launch window

Rishi —

Thanks for the summary. I reviewed MAP_Nimbus_v3.pdf and the single retention clause tweak you mentioned looks reasonable. Proposed language: 

"Redwood will retain customer telemetry and audit logs for a period not to exceed 24 months unless otherwise required by law or mutual agreement in writing."

That should satisfy Nimbus' standard while keeping our retention posture. Legal would prefer we flag the clause in the final packet rather than sending as a late redline. If Nimbus is okay, we can include it in the final DocuSign envelope as a tracked change and provide a brief remark in the cover email.

Additionally: any negotiated SLA credits need to be on the SOW exhibit; I don’t see a need for an SLA exception here, but confirm with the customer.

-Kim
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

> On Thu, Nov 5, 2026 at 09:12 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Team / Nimbus —
> > (see above)

From: Jordan Pierce <jordan.pierce@nimbushealth.com>
To: Leslie Hahn <leslie@nimbushealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 13:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Concluding MAP & eval gate — paperstack timing for launch window

Rishi / Kim / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. Quick answers from our side: 

- Signers: confirmed — Leslie Hahn (Head of Procurement) + myself (VP Product).
- Data retention language looks fine; I’ll ask Procurement to accept the proposed phrasing.
- Timing: Procurement has a tight window the week of 11/15; if you can send the DocuSign envelope on 11/16 we’ll prioritize review and aim to complete signing by 11/18.
- Start date: we still prefer 12/06 but are open to 12/13 if your ops team needs another week for the dedicated capacity ramp.

Leslie, I’ll loop you on the DocuSign packet when Redwood sends it.

Jordan
VP Product, Nimbus Health

----
Forwarded attachment references: MAP_Nimbus_v3.pdf, nimbus-eval-summary.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Leslie Hahn <leslie@nimbushealth.com>, Jordan Pierce <jordan.pierce@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Legal Team <legal@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: DocuSign packet & final schedule (action: please sign)

Leslie / Jordan —

Thanks for the quick turnaround commitment. We’ve prepared the final packet and routed the retention clause as agreed. DocuSign envelope is ready: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/room/XYZ-123456 (packet: Redwood_Master_SA_Nimbus.pdf + SOW_ProdDeployment_12-06.pdf + Exhibit_Security).

Requested timeline: please sign by 11/18 EOD so we can schedule a preflight call 11/29 and proceed with a 12/06 start. If you need 48 additional hours, let us know and we’ll shift to 12/13.

Attachments: redwood-docusign-invite.pdf (envelope summary)

Thanks —
Rishi

> On Mon, Nov 9, 2026 at 13:24 Jordan Pierce <jordan.pierce@nimbushealth.com> wrote:
> > (see below)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Leslie Hahn <leslie@nimbushealth.com>, Jordan Pierce <jordan.pierce@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Ops & CS readiness + preflight checklist for launch window

Team / Nimbus —

Quick operational confirmation to close the loop: 

- Ops readiness: Dedicated pool scheduled for warm-up starting 11/30, capacity validated for the agreed throughput. We will hold a 60-minute preflight on 11/29 (invite to follow).
- CS onboarding: onboarding runbook is attached and CS will schedule the technical kickoff on day 0+1.
- Risk items: fallback model variant configured; traffic shaping policy ready in case we need an immediate throttle during the first week.

If the envelope is executed by 11/18 we’re green to hit 12/06. If signatures complete 11/20–11/22 we’ll target 12/13 (minor ops timeline shift).

Action items: 
1) Leslie/Jordan — confirm sign-by date (11/18 preferred).
2) Kim — final confirm on the retention clause being included in the envelope.
3) Rishi — send the DocuSign reminder Monday morning if not signed.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: onboarding-runbook-v1.pdf (ops runbook; referenced), MAP_Nimbus_v3.pdf (for easy reference)
